'''Kothlis''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Moving Target" /> located in the [[Kothlis system]] within [[Bothan Space]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Appendix" /> [[Luke Skywalker]] was stationed on Kothlis during the conclusion of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] involvement in [[Operation Yellow Moon]]. Following the completion of her mission, Organa contacted Skywalker at Kothlis, from where he informed her that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] had discovered the [[Boba Fett's Palace|whereabouts]] of [[Han Solo]], still trapped in [[carbonite]]. Organa informed Skywalker that she would tell him about an idea she had about a role she could play in their attempt to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] Solo when she reached Kothlis.<ref name="Moving Target" />
